EITS-AWS-001.title: New access key used for AdministratorAccess policy attachment
EITS-AWS-001.description: Correlate a successful key creation with use of that exact key for a successful administrative managed-policy attachment within 30 minutes.
EITS-AWS-001.exact_logic: sql/EITS-AWS-001.sql; same account and created key = caller credential; 0 < elapsed <= 1800 seconds; successful AttachUserPolicy or AttachRolePolicy for arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess
EITS-AWS-001.why_it_matters: A new persistent credential immediately changes a powerful identity permission assignment.
expected_false_positives: Administrative credential rotation followed by approved provisioning
EITS-AWS-001.tuning: Review actor, credential owner, policy recipient, and change authorization. Any future exception must specify account, actor, target, expiry, and rationale. No suppressions ship in Phase 1.
limitations: Requires the issued key ID; no fallback to IP or username
Direct long-lived-key use only; no STS role-chain reconstruction
Commercial AWS partition and exact AdministratorAccess policy only
Missing or equal timestamps cannot establish the required ordering
cannot_establish: A net privilege increase or effective administrator access
Policy use, persistence duration, or actor authorization
EITS-AWS-001.observed: A completed CreateAccessKey record and later policy attachment report no error; the issued key ID equals the later caller credential.
EITS-AWS-001.inferred: The sequence warrants investigation for credential misuse or unauthorized permission changes; intent is unresolved.

EITS-AWS-002.title: Logging stop followed by public administrative-port ingress
EITS-AWS-002.description: Correlate a successful StopLogging with successful public SSH/RDP-capable security-group ingress by the same account, principal and credential within 30 minutes.
EITS-AWS-002.exact_logic: sql/EITS-AWS-002.sql; same account/principal/credential; 0 < elapsed <= 1800 seconds; same permission contains public IPv4/IPv6 and all protocols or TCP range including 22 or 3389
EITS-AWS-002.why_it_matters: The actor requests a logging stop followed by broader administrative network permissions.
expected_false_positives: Approved trail maintenance and emergency network access
A logging restart between the two events
EITS-AWS-002.tuning: Review intervening StartLogging events and explicit change authorization. Scope any future suppression to account, trail, group, actor and expiry; measure lost coverage.
limitations: No trail-selector or effective routing snapshot
Missing principal/credential IDs cannot be correlated
No identity joins based on source IP
Delayed activity and other sessions are outside the window/join
cannot_establish: All cloud logging stopped; Event History is independent
The changed trail covered the EC2 event
Internet reachability, a listening service, connection or exploitation
Malicious intent or lack of authorization
EITS-AWS-002.observed: Completed StopLogging and public administrative-port ingress authorization records report no error and match on account, principal and credential.
EITS-AWS-002.inferred: The temporal sequence warrants investigation; logging coverage and effective network reachability remain unresolved.
